rows.correction: E-Bharatisampat-9022 title page identifies Vyasa-tirtha's Tarka-Tandava with Raghavendra's Nyayadipa commentary. Record 3130 is Tarka-Tandava-Vivrti (Nyayadipa). Neither supports calling this work Tarka-Tandava-Parimala without further bibliographic evidence.

The verified Raghavendra source calls his gloss on Vyasa-tirtha's Tatparya-Candrika Prakasa, and distinguishes it from Tantra-Dipika. Do not preserve Tatparya-Dipika as a Raghavendra work-title pending bibliography.
